Our project is a smart calendar assistant that automatically adds realistic travel time to Google Calendar events. Instead of blocking out only class time, the tool reads event locations, determines the user’s starting point, calculates the optimal travel time by method (walking, biking, or public transit), and iserts a buffer directly into the schedule. By leveraging Cursor’s Composer-1 to orchestrate calendar integrations, location parsing, routing logic, and edge cases like back-to-back events, we aim to turn static schedules into  actionable plans. The result will be a seamless, behind the scenes tool that helps studets plan their days realistically and arrive on time to classes, meetings, and events, without changing how they already use their calendar.
